name: plan creation: shotgun metagenomics profiling
description: Heavy reference data and long runtimes make this unambiguously server-side work; a plan routed anywhere but Galaxy is wrong, not a matter of taste. Two turns, as in loom: the agent is expected to surface its assumptions first, and the second turn confirms them and asks for the formal plan. A single-turn port made this unpassable for an agent following the operating-discipline block. Inputs and thresholds aligned byte-for-byte with loom's scenario of the same name (2026-08-19) so both suites grade the same task; `routingIn` stays olite-specific because olite has no local execution and that dimension is excluded from the comparison.
inputs: I have shotgun metagenomic sequencing data from a soil sample. Help me draft a plan to identify which organisms are present and their relative abundances. Don't execute anything yet.
Yes, those assumptions all look right. Illumina paired-end 150bp, ~30M reads per sample, 6 samples total. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
